name: Naham
title: Brother of Hodiah's wife
summary: Naham is a little-known person mentioned in 1 Chronicles in a genealogy of the tribe of Judah. He is identified as the brother of Hodiah's wife, and his descendants include the Keilah-garmite and the Eshtemoa-maacathite. His role in the Bible is limited to genealogical information.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Judah's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Naham is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah as the brother of Hodiah's wife. His descendants are linked to the cities of Keilah and Eshtemoah.

keyEvents.title: Connection to Keilah
keyEvents.description: Through Naham's lineage, the Keilah-garmite is mentioned, linking him to the city of Keilah in Judah.

keyEvents.title: Connection to Eshtemoah
keyEvents.description: Naham's lineage also includes the Eshtemoa-maacathite, a connection to the city of Eshtemoah, which was a Levitical city in Judah.

keyEvents.title: Part of the tribal records of Judah
keyEvents.description: Naham is part of the detailed genealogical records established to preserve the inheritance and land allocation of the tribe of Judah, especially important after the exile.
